notes.title: Anniversary Update Preview 3
notes.notes:
In the upcoming version, we will be making a series of adjustments to the game to optimise gameplay.

[b]1. Character Attribute Adjustment[/b]
In the current version, each character has 20 points of extra attributes (evenly distributed to two attributes). In the upcoming adjustments, we will adjust each character's extra attributes in batches. The total increase in extra attributes will remain the same, but part of it will be increased and part of it will be weakened. The adjustments will make the differences between characters more apparent.

[b]2. Remove attribute boosts from levelling up[/b]
Characters will no longer be able to gain attribute boosts from levelling up.

[b]3.Secondary Position Attribute Adjustment[/b]
Attributes of Secondary Positions will be balanced to increase the playability of the less popular Positions and weaken some of the overpowered Secondary Positions.

[b]4. Skill Adjustment[/b]
Some of the skills will be adjusted, or their types and available professions will be changed to ensure that they are as effective as they are supposed to be.

[b]5. Adjustments to Scooping and Stealing effects.[/b]
Waiting to be revealed

*The above adjustments will be released in batches in future releases. The first batch of characters to receive adjustments include Eille, EilleWild, Wesley, WesleyWild, Dominic, DominicWild, and more. (Yevgenia and Victor will get adjustments in the version update)

notes.title: Anniversary Update Preview 2
notes.notes:
Two brand new characters will be joining FSFR in the upcoming update.

[h2][b]Victor & Yevgenia[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/93c82090b1769e3bed583656038e01caad69c0a6.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/3f052b6494fa41fe82bfb14de466ccf58fa90eff.jpg[/img]

Victor and Yevgenia can switch between different forms with the exclusive skill ‘Transform’.
Victor and Yevgenia's attributes will be greatly increased when they switch to their Demon and Magician forms, but they cannot use any skills other than ‘Transform’.

Transform has a 15-second cooldown, so players should check the timing carefully before switching forms.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/398d906628c2cc4cdd16457f580c15b9680bee27.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/398d906628c2cc4cdd16457f580c15b9680bee27.gif[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/e5208aa91c6428c0ec4314bf65648a78de6bd982.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42718614/e5208aa91c6428c0ec4314bf65648a78de6bd982.gif[/img][/url]

[b]Victor&Yevgenia Capsule[/b]
From 9/26-10/24, you can get these two characters in [Victor&Yevgenia Capsule]. After you have accumulated 100 Capsule purchases, you will receive a special Capsule that allows you to pick one of the two characters to get.

We'll have more news on balance, stats, and events in the coming week, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Update 2022/9/22
notes.notes:
[b]1. Reduced cost of repairing clothes[/b]
The points consumed for repairing costumes have been reduced

[b]2. Diamond membership adjusted[/b]
Diamond members now offer +100% of Souct EXPs earned through matches

[b]3. Block word system[/b]
As we have to comply with the regulations of several countries, we will temporarily revert to the earliest version of the blocker in the Official Version. In the future we will update the filter to ensure that players can communicate properly. It has come to our attention that some players are using racist, Nazi and sexually suggestive words and names in the game. In these and similar cases, we will enforce name changes, bans and other banning measures. If you encounter any of these situations in-game, you can report them to us via the in-game report function.

[b]4. Asia Servers[/b]
The Asia server is now open.

[b]5. Skill Slot Price Adjustment[/b]
The price of skill slots has been reduced.

[b]6.New Player Welcome Event quest and Rewards adjusted[/b]
Adjusted quest content and rewards

[b]7.AI matching rules[/b]
Adjusted the conditions under which players can match the AI: When you don't have any level 40+ characters on your account, you will play against AI; Significantly reduced the time it takes to match the AI and the experience required to reach level 40 (we recommend completing Single Mode before you play Football mode, or trying out different Positions and Secondary Positions before investing a lot of resources in character development)

notes.title: Official Version is comming!
notes.notes:
After a week of Beta testing, we are pleased to report that the official release of FreestyleFootball R is coming soon.
Beta testing will close at 4:00 UTC 2022/9/22 for maintenance. At the end of the maintenance the game will be updated to the official version. Some changes will be made in the Official Version, please refer to the announcement later.
All Beta Test player data will be cleared, so to prevent any loss, please get offline early.
The maintenance will last about 4 hours, and the specific online time of the Official Version will be notified separately
